book.title: 1934: Caught in the Crossroads
book.tagline: A relic from the Crusades resurfaces, threatening a world already on the brink.
description: Europe, 1934. The scars of the Great War have not healed, and something buried for centuries has begun to surface.

An archaeological discovery in Yugoslavia uncovers records pointing toward the True Cross — lost after Saladin's victory at Hattin, carried by the Ottomans to the walls of Vienna, and hidden somewhere in the ruins of Eastern Europe for two hundred and fifty years. When Nazi operatives move to seize what the records describe, four unlikely allies are pulled into a race from Ljubljana to Bucharest.

A war veteran turned security director. His actress sister, who insisted on coming. A Yugoslav archaeologist who found what he shouldn't have. A German academic the new regime expelled for knowing too much.
But a German officer is already ahead of them — one who has been moving pieces on this board since before they knew the game existed.
1934: Caught in the Crossroads is a historical adventure about ideology, memory, and the people caught between the collapsing world behind them and the one rushing forward to replace it.
